transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well… I’ve been making these small mistakes lately. Like putting the wrong time down on a senior center class sheet, or measuring a board and still cutting it just a little short because I missed the fine print. It’s not huge, but it’s been happening enough that I thought I should come in.
Do you remember the correct information at the time, but somehow write or do the wrong thing?
Yeah… I think so. I’ll have the right idea in my head, but then I write down the wrong time or miss the fine print and do it wrong anyway. It’s usually small stuff like that.
Do you feel like you're paying attention when you're making these mistakes?
I feel like I am, mostly. But then I still miss some little detail… like I’ll write the wrong time down, or measure something and cut it just a bit short because I skipped over the small print.
Do you remember making these mistakes right after they happen?
Usually, yeah. I’ll notice right after—like, “I just wrote the wrong time,” or I’ll see the board’s a little short after I already cut it. It’s small stuff, but it’s frustrating.
Do you have trouble remembering things that happened more than a day ago?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I’ve noticed a big problem with that… not more than usual, anyway.
Do you have trouble learning new information?
I don’t know… I haven’t really noticed that. I guess it depends what kind of information you mean.
Do you have trouble planning or organizing tasks?

Yeah, a little. If I’ve got a few errands and maybe something in the workshop to set up, plus an appointment, I don’t always put it in the right order. I’ll start one thing, stop, go to another, and then I’m rushing at the end.
Have you been feeling anxious or on edge lately?
Not especially. I mean, everybody gets a bit wound up now and then, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been on edge much lately.
Do you often forget where you placed things like your keys or wallet?
Yeah… that happens. I’ll set down my keys or my reading glasses, or even a tape measure, and a few minutes later I’m walking around trying to find them. More than I’d like, I guess.
Do you ever struggle to find the right words when you're talking or writing?
Not really, no. I mean, maybe once in a while a word won’t come right away, but I haven’t noticed it being a real problem.
Have you noticed any changes in your ability to concentrate over the past few months?

A little, maybe. At the senior center, if folks are talking at the next table or my phone lights up, I’ll kind of lose my place in what I’m filling out or working on. It’s not terrible, but I notice it.
Have you needed more help from others to manage your daily activities than you used to?

A bit, yeah. I don’t like to make a big thing of it, but my wife’s been checking plans more lately so I don’t mess up family visits or things at the center. And I’ve kind of stepped back from helping lead a couple of DIY workshops because of the mix-ups.
Do you have trouble recalling recent events, such as what you did yesterday or last week?
Not really. I mean, I can usually remember what I did yesterday or last week well enough. Sometimes I have to think for a minute, but I wouldn’t say it’s a big problem.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your mental abilities over the past year?
Yeah… I suppose since we moved into the condo. That was about a year and a month ago. That’s when it started feeling like it was getting in the way more, I guess.
Have you had any significant medical conditions or illnesses over the past year?
No… not that I can think of. Nothing significant, anyway.
Do you think your mistakes and difficulties with tasks have been getting worse over time?

Maybe a little worse, yeah. It’s mostly small mistakes. Like I’ll write the wrong time on a senior-center class sheet, or I measure a board and still cut it just a bit short because I missed the small print. Stuff like that.
Have you noticed any decline in your ability to perform tasks that you used to do easily?

Yeah… a bit. I’ve kind of backed off from helping lead a couple of the DIY workshops, because I don’t trust myself not to mix something up. And my wife’s been checking plans more, so I don’t mess up family visits or things at the center.
Do you have trouble remembering important dates or events, like birthdays or anniversaries?
Not really… I mean, I don’t think so. My wife keeps track of most of that stuff, so I may not be the best judge. But I haven’t noticed missing big dates, no.
Have you noticed your mistakes or difficulties with tasks increasing in frequency over the past few months?

Yeah… I think so, a little. It’s not big things, just I keep messing up small details more often—like putting the wrong time on a class sheet, or measuring a board and still cutting it a bit short because I missed the fine print.
Have you noticed your ability to perform daily tasks declining over the past year?

Yeah… somewhat. I wouldn’t say everything’s fallen apart, but I’ve stepped back from helping lead a couple of the DIY workshops because I don’t want to mix things up. And at home my wife checks plans more now, so I don’t throw off family visits or stuff at the center.
